about_p1: Maju LSK Logistics and Foodfare Sdn Bhd is your dedicated partner in elevating foodservice excellence. As a leading importer and wholesaler of premium food ingredients in Brunei Darussalam, we provide a comprehensive range of products tailored to the needs of bakeries, coffee shops, and other food service establishments.
about_p2: Our commitment to quality, coupled with our extensive product selection and reliable service, ensures that you have everything you need to create exceptional culinary experiences.
about_p3: Maju LSK Logistics & Foodfare Sdn Bhd is the sole and appointed distributor for more than 50 local and overseas agencies.
about_f1_desc: Finest ingredients from around the world
lsk_meaning_short: LSK stands for Low Soo Kheng — a tribute to our founder's late mother.
lsk_meaning: LSK stands for Low Soo Kheng — the name of the late mother of founder and CEO, Mr. Sam Ying Kok. The company name is a tribute and loving dedication to his mother, making Maju LSK more than just a business — it is a family legacy.

andong_desc: Your essential supplier for dairy, frozen, and paper products. Also the sole distributor for Genki! Baby Diaper in Brunei.
